detail.longDescription:
I spent some time playing with Readest - an #opensource e-reader app suite and sync server. It seems to work really quite well, and best of all there's a koreader plugin so I can sync between my kobo and phone pretty much seamlessly - both progress and annotations (which is a big deal for me). I haven't been able to do that since I left the Kindle ecosystem.

Self-hosting isn't really catered for, but being OSS I imagine that's probably just a matter of time. 

The only shortcoming so far is that the koreader plugin doesn't handle PDFs well, but the Readest apps themselves do a great job of it.
